hypothesis: A separately supervised per-event, per-horizon harm-risk head can reduce harmful Wiki interventions while retaining positive expected-gain interventions.

decision_rule.pilot_success: validation MAE below the paired trend model and lower intervention harm than frozen v1 without a provenance or leakage failure
decision_rule.pilot_failure: no MAE improvement or a methodological/provenance failure; do not tune the 0.5 threshold on this validation result
decision_rule.expansion: only after pilot success, freeze the exact configuration and run the remaining predeclared fold/seed combinations

locked_rules: Do not change the parent Wiki, residual experts, folds, trend checkpoint or gain threshold in this pilot.
Do not use validation or test labels to fit the harm head, choose its threshold or clean data.
Do not access the sealed test split.
Do not present this exploratory fold as final statistical evidence.
